stories.headline: WHO declares Ebola outbreak in DR Congo a global health emergency
stories.summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) has declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda a "public health emergency of international concern". The declaration was made after over 300 suspected cases and 88 deaths were reported. The outbreak is caused by a rare Ebola virus strain, specifically the Bundibugyo strain, with no known vaccine. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the decision on Sunday, citing the need for international attention and cooperation to contain the outbreak. Health officials are working to control the spread of the virus, with reported cases and deaths in the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda. The WHO's declaration aims to mobilize global support and resources to combat the outbreak.

stories.headline: WHO declares Ebola outbreak in Congo, Uganda an emergency of international concern
stories.summary: The World Health Organization (WHO) has declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda a "public health emergency of international concern". The declaration was made after the virus killed nearly 90 people and over 246 suspected cases were linked to the outbreak. The WHO made the announcement on Sunday, citing risks to neighboring countries. The outbreak is caused by a new strain of the Ebola virus, which has primarily affected equatorial Africa. The declaration is an international call to action, aiming to prevent further spread of the disease and protect global health. The WHO's decision highlights the severity of the outbreak and the need for a coordinated international response to contain it. Neighboring countries are at risk, and the WHO's declaration seeks to mobilize resources to support the affected regions.

stories.headline: The New Cold War Runs Through Factories, Refineries, and Supply Chains China's dominance over industrial supply chains gives it geopolitical leverage, marking the shift to Great Powers Era 2.0 beyond trade
stories.summary: China's dominance over industrial supply chains gives it significant geopolitical leverage, marking a shift to Great Powers Era 2.0. The country's complex domestic manufacturing ecosystem makes it challenging for companies to relocate, as seen in Apple's struggles to produce iPhones in India. Tesla's experiences also highlight the difficulties of shifting supply chains. The US and China are engaged in a trade war, with tensions escalating as the rare earth truce is set to expire on November 10. China's industrial output continues to expand, outpacing the US, while Eurasian trade integration deepens through infrastructure and energy agreements. The trade war is fueling geopolitical tensions and reshaping global supply chains, presenting opportunities and risks for emerging economies as businesses consider alternative production locations. The US-China trade dynamics are set to continue, with potential implications for global trade and geopolitics.

stories.headline: London Imam gets life in jail for raping girls using claims of ‘supernatural powers’, ‘jinn’
stories.summary: Abdul Halim Khan, a London Imam, has been sentenced to life in jail for raping and sexually assaulting seven girls from the Muslim community over nine years. Khan, an Indian national, claimed to have supernatural powers and used the concept of "jinn" to coerce his victims, some as young as 12. He pretended to be possessed by a supernatural spirit to abuse the girls. Khan was convicted of 21 counts of sex assault and rape. The Metropolitan Police investigation revealed that Khan exploited his position as a faith leader to carry out the attacks. His victims were all from the Muslim community, and the abuse took place over a period of nine years. Khan's sentence reflects the severity of his crimes and the harm caused to his victims.

stories.headline: Apple's M5 silicon has reportedly been exploited for the first time in a public macOS kernel memory corruption attack, successfully bypassing the company's nota
stories.summary: Apple's M5 silicon has been exploited in a public macOS kernel memory corruption attack, bypassing the company's hardware-level memory protection. Researchers used Anthropic Mythos to successfully exploit the M5 silicon, achieving this in just five days. This is notable as Apple spent five years developing hardware and software to make memory corruption exploits more difficult. The team behind the exploit, working with Mythos Preview, was able to bypass Apple's new M5 security protections. The exploit demonstrates a vulnerability in the M5 silicon, despite Apple's efforts to enhance security. The researchers have shared details on how they used Mythos Preview to achieve the exploit, highlighting the potential risks and weaknesses in Apple's M5 security measures. This is the first public macOS kernel exploit on Apple M5 silicon.

stories.headline: Infinix NOTE 60 Series wins Red Dot, iF, Golden A'Design, and MUSE awards, highlighting the brand’s growing focus on premium smartphone design.
stories.summary: Infinix NOTE 60 Series has won several global design awards, including the Red Dot Award 2026, iF DESIGN AWARD 2026, and Golden A'Design Award 2026 for the NOTE 60 Ultra. The NOTE 60 Pro also received a Platinum Winner award at the MUSE Design Awards 2026. These awards highlight Infinix's focus on premium smartphone design, particularly with the NOTE 60 Ultra, which was developed in collaboration with Italian design firm Pininfarina. The NOTE 60 Ultra features a 200MP camera, satellite communication, and 512GB storage. The awards recognize the series' premium aesthetics, craftsmanship, and user experience, strengthening Infinix's position in the premium smartphone market. The collaboration with Pininfarina marks a first for the 95-year-old design firm, which has previously focused on automotive design. The awards demonstrate Infinix's commitment to delivering high-quality, stylish devices.

stories.headline: NEOWIZ’s Round8 Studio is ramping up recruitment as it expands a multititle development pipeline, with the studio emphasizing a hiring philosophy c
stories.summary: NEOWIZ's Round8 Studio is expanding its development pipeline and recruiting new talent for various projects, including the sequel to 'Lies of P' and new subculture-themed titles. The studio is hiring for multiple roles, notably an 'AI Creator' to integrate generative AI into game graphic production. This move suggests a new production direction, utilizing AI to improve efficiency and visuals in upcoming titles. Round8 Studio is using Stable Diffusion to generate game graphics, indicating a focus on innovation and technological advancement. The recruitment drive is part of the studio's efforts to ramp up its development pipeline, with multiple titles in the works. The hiring philosophy emphasizes bringing in new talent to support the studio's growing ambitions and production goals.

stories.headline: Rare Pokémon cards can sell for hundreds or even thousands of dollars, with a record sale of one Pikachu card going for over $22 million earlier this year.
stories.summary: A rare Pikachu Illustrator promo card sold for a record $900,000, becoming the most expensive Pokémon card ever sold. However, this record was short-lived, as another Pikachu card was previously reported to have sold for over $22 million earlier this year. YouTuber Logan Paul owned a highly coveted Pokémon card that sold for over $16 million. In 2021, Paul paid over $5 million for a single Pokémon card, a Pikachu card, which he wore as a chain to a wrestling match. The global trading value of rare Pokémon cards can reach hundreds or thousands of dollars, with some sales exceeding millions. These high-value sales demonstrate the significant demand and worth of rare Pokémon cards among collectors.

stories.headline: Lewis Hamilton to Retire ‘When He Realizes He Can’t Win,' Steiner
stories.summary: Lewis Hamilton will retire from Formula 1 when he realizes he cannot win an eighth world championship, according to former Haas team principal Guenther Steiner. Steiner believes Hamilton's decision to retire depends on his ability to secure another title, not on external validation or reputation. Hamilton left Mercedes after 12 seasons and joined Ferrari for 2025, but had a career-worst debut season, finishing sixth in the standings with no podiums. Steiner's comments suggest that Hamilton's motivation to continue racing is driven by his desire to win another championship, and when he realizes this is no longer possible, he will choose to retire. Hamilton's move to Ferrari ended his successful partnership with Mercedes, which produced six drivers' titles and eight constructors' crowns. His performance in 2026 will be crucial in determining his future in F1.

stories.headline: Man United lineup vs Nottingham Forest predicted as Casemiro handed final Old Trafford start
stories.summary: Manchester United's lineup against Nottingham Forest has been announced by Michael Carrick. The starting XI includes Bayindir, Lindelof, De Ligt, Martinez, Dalot, Ugarte, Casemiro, Fernandes, Rashford, Garnacho, and Zirkzee. Casemiro is set to make his final Old Trafford appearance, partnering with Ugarte in midfield. The match is part of Manchester United's final home game of the season. The team's traveling squad to face Nottingham Forest was also released, featuring goalkeepers Altay Bayindir and Andre Onana, and defenders Diogo Dalot and Matthijs De Ligt. The predicted lineup had some variations, but Carrick's official selection has been confirmed. The match is expected to kick off, with Manchester United taking an early lead against Forest at Old Trafford.

stories.headline: Man Utd news: Carrick can agree bargain first transfer as Rashford risks breaking unwritten rule
stories.summary: Manchester United is expected to confirm Michael Carrick's appointment as permanent head coach within 48 hours. Carrick will reportedly receive a two-year contract with an option to extend for an additional year. As the new head coach, Carrick is set to make his first transfer move, with potential deals being considered. Meanwhile, Marcus Rashford's situation is being monitored, as he may be at risk of breaking an unwritten rule. The club is also rumored to be considering other transfers, including Richard Rios. Casemiro has expressed concerns about the development of youngster Mainoo, which may impact Carrick's transfer decisions. With Carrick's appointment imminent, Manchester United fans await news on his first transfer moves as head coach. The club's transfer plans are expected to become clearer in the coming days.

stories.headline: Joseph Paul Amoah storms into 200m final
stories.summary: Joseph Paul Amoah has qualified for the 200m final at the African Championships. Amoah, who holds Ghana's 200m record, previously made history by becoming the first Ghanaian to qualify for the 2020 Summer Olympics with a personal best time of 20.20 seconds in 2019. He was also named Ghana's flagbearer for the 2024 Olympic Games in Paris. Amoah will lead Ghana's delegation at the 2026 African Senior Athletics Championship. In recent semi-finals, he finished fourth with a time of 10.32 seconds, ahead of Ghana's national 100m record holder Saminu, who finished sixth with 10.36 seconds. Amoah remains one of Ghana's strongest hopes in the sprint events as the championships continue at the University of Ghana Stadium. His qualification for the 200m final solidifies his position as a top athlete in Ghana.

stories.headline: President Murmu promulgates ordinance to increase Supreme Court judge strength by four
stories.summary: President Droupadi Murmu has promulgated the Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Amendment Ordinance, 2026, increasing the sanctioned strength of Supreme Court judges from 33 to 37, excluding the Chief Justice of India (CJI). Including the CJI, the total strength will rise from 34 to 38. The ordinance was approved after the Union Cabinet's decision nearly two weeks ago. A gazette notification, dated May 16, stated that the President took immediate action as Parliament is not in session. The move amends the Supreme Court (Number of Judges) Act, 1956, which initially provided for a maximum of 10 judges, excluding the CJI. The ordinance aims to increase the judicial strength of the Supreme Court, with the total number of judges now standing at 38, including the CJI. The decision was made to take immediate action due to the urgency of the matter.

stories.headline: PM Modi returns to Sweden for first visit since 2018: Here’s what’s on the agenda
stories.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has returned to Sweden for his first visit since 2018. He is expected to hold bilateral talks with Swedish Prime Minister Kristersson, covering the entire range of bilateral relations. The key agenda items include collaboration on artificial intelligence, semiconductors, space, green industry, and joint defence manufacturing under the "Make in India" initiative. On May 17, Prime Minister Modi will undertake an official visit to Gothenburg, Sweden. The visit aims to strengthen trade between India and Sweden, with discussions focusing on areas of mutual interest and cooperation. This is Prime Minister Modi's second visit to Sweden, following his previous visit in 2018. The talks are expected to enhance the bilateral relationship between the two countries.

stories.headline: Fire breaks out on Thiruvananthapuram-Hazrat Nizamuddin Rajdhani Express near Ratlam, passengers evacuated
stories.summary: A fire broke out in an AC coach of the Thiruvananthapuram-Hazrat Nizamuddin Rajdhani Express in Madhya Pradesh's Ratlam district on Sunday morning. The incident occurred at 5:15 am near Alot station, with 68 passengers in the affected coach. Railway officials confirmed that all passengers were evacuated safely, with no injuries or casualties reported. The fire was detected in the B-1 coach of the train, which falls under the Kota Railway Division. The train, numbered 12431, was traveling from Thiruvananthapuram to Hazrat Nizamuddin when the incident occurred. Authorities responded promptly, ensuring the safe evacuation of all passengers from the affected coach. An investigation into the cause of the fire is likely to follow. The swift response of the railway officials and emergency services helped prevent any harm to the passengers.

stories.headline: Man slits woman’s throat in full public view for rejecting his proposal in Telangana
stories.summary: A 21-year-old receptionist, Y Vaishnavi, was murdered in Jadcherla, Telangana, after rejecting a man's proposal. The accused allegedly slit her throat in full public view. The incident is similar to other recent cases in India, including the murder of a 20-year-old pharmacy student, Yamini Priya, who was killed near Malleswaram's Mantri Mall after rejecting a man's romantic advances. In another case, a man was arrested in Telangana's Mahbubnagar for allegedly killing his wife by slitting her throat and setting her ablaze. These incidents have sparked widespread outrage and protests from Hindu organizations, highlighting the issue of violence against women in India. The accused in Vaishnavi's case has been arrested and remanded to judicial custody. The police are investigating the motives behind these brutal murders.

stories.headline: India, Netherlands Elevating Ties To Strategic Partnership: PM Modi After Talks With Dutch Counterpart
stories.summary: India and the Netherlands have elevated their relationship to a strategic partnership level after extensive talks between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and his Dutch counterpart. The discussions, held during PM Modi's visit to the Netherlands, reviewed bilateral cooperation in areas such as trade, defense, technology, and water management. The two countries aim to expand cooperation in trade, investment, and semiconductors. The elevation of ties marks a significant milestone in India-Europe relations. PM Modi's visit to the Netherlands was a key factor in this development, with both sides expected to strengthen their partnership in various sectors. The strategic partnership is expected to further deepen the bilateral relationship between India and the Netherlands.

stories.headline: US and China Hold High-Level Talks Amid Rising Tensions Over Trade and Security
stories.summary: US and Chinese officials held high-level talks in Geneva, marking the first face-to-face conversations since the US imposed new tariffs on Chinese goods. The talks aimed to address rising tensions over trade, technology, and regional security issues. US President Donald Trump is set to meet Chinese President Xi Jinping in Beijing for a summit, with trade being a top agenda item. The meeting comes amid recent tensions over the Iran war and other issues, including AI and security. Businesses hope for key deals and an extension of the tariff truce, which is due to expire in November. Despite mounting tensions, both Washington and Beijing appear determined to prevent the relationship from sliding into deeper confrontation, with the visit marked by warm rhetoric and symbolism. The talks are a crucial step in easing tensions between the two nations.

stories.headline: Russia and Ukraine Engage in Diplomatic Efforts to End Ongoing Conflict
stories.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin has suggested that the war in Ukraine may be nearing its end, expressing willingness to meet with Ukrainian leaders. This comes after a call between Putin and former US President Donald Trump, where they expressed support for a brief ceasefire. The US-led effort to end the nearly 4-year-old conflict has gained momentum, with ongoing diplomatic talks between Russia and Ukraine. A fresh round of negotiations is currently underway, aiming to resolve the ongoing conflict. Putin has reiterated his belief that the war is coming to an end, sparking speculation about potential diplomatic breakthroughs. Leaders and diplomats continue to engage in efforts to bring a peaceful resolution to the conflict, with the international community monitoring the situation closely. Diplomatic efforts are ongoing, with the goal of achieving a lasting ceasefire and peace agreement.

stories.headline: North Korea Launches Ballistic Missile Into Sea of Japan, Escalating Regional Tensions
stories.summary: North Korea launched a ballistic missile into the Sea of Japan, escalating regional tensions. The launch follows the start of joint US-South Korea military drills. Japan and South Korea suspect the projectile was a ballistic missile, with no damage reported. This incident occurs amid ongoing diplomatic efforts to resume dialogue with North Korea. The country recently test-fired approximately 10 ballistic missiles from its upgraded launcher system, targeting an island in the Sea of Japan. The missiles landed outside Japan's exclusive economic zone. The launch is seen as a show of force, possibly in response to the joint military drills and ahead of a major political congress in North Korea. The incident has drawn attention from Tokyo and Seoul, heightening tensions in East Asia. Diplomatic efforts continue to try to resume talks with North Korea.

stories.headline: India scrambles to steady rupee as oil shock bites
stories.summary: India is struggling to stabilize the rupee as surging oil prices, driven by the Middle East conflict, put pressure on the currency. The rupee has fallen to a record low, passing 96 per dollar, making it Asia's worst-performing major currency in 2026. This decline is largely due to oil-driven trade and investment pressures, as India relies heavily on oil and coal imports. The country's rapid growth is under threat from the rising oil prices, which are disrupting its economy. India is taking measures to salvage the sinking rupee, including potential rate hikes and currency backstops, in an effort to mitigate the impact of the oil shock and support its economic growth. The situation remains volatile, with the rupee's value continuing to fluctuate in response to global market developments.

stories.headline: India increases customs duty on gold to 15% to conserve foreign exchange
stories.summary: India has increased the customs duty on gold to 15% from 10.75% to conserve foreign exchange reserves. The government has also raised import tariffs on silver and platinum to 15%. The move aims to reduce the current account deficit and prioritize essential imports amid rising global economic pressure and geopolitical tensions. The higher duties are expected to dampen demand for gold in India, which is one of the largest consumers of the precious metal. The increase in import duty is part of the government's efforts to manage foreign exchange reserves and mitigate the impact of a widening trade deficit. The new duty rate is effective immediately, and it is expected to have a significant impact on India's gold and precious metals market. The government's decision is seen as a measure to conserve foreign exchange and stabilize the economy.

stories.headline: Japan opposition to grill PM on extra budget in leaders' debate
stories.summary: Japan's opposition parties will question Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi about plans for a fiscal 2026 supplementary budget. The extra budget aims to address rising crude oil prices and inflation due to Middle East turmoil. The debate will focus on the government's response to economic challenges. The opposition seeks to scrutinize the prime minister's handling of the economy and the proposed budget. This comes as Japan prepares for a general election and faces ongoing economic pressures. The finance minister has also indicated that the G7 will discuss bond volatility next week, highlighting the global economic concerns. The opposition's grilling of the prime minister is part of a broader effort to hold the government accountable for its economic policies and decisions.

stories.headline: Japan's opposition parties are set to grill Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi over plans for an extra budget
stories.summary: Japan's opposition parties are set to question Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi over plans for a fiscal 2026 supplementary budget. The grilling is expected to take place during a party leaders' debate, where opposition parties will address the delay in preparing the extra budget. The supplementary budget aims to address various issues, and the opposition parties are seeking clarification on the plans. Prime Minister Takaichi's administration has been under scrutiny, and this debate marks one of her first parliamentary debates since taking office. The opposition parties will likely press for details on the budget and the government's intentions, seeking to hold the administration accountable for its actions. The debate is scheduled to take place on Wednesday, with leaders of four opposition parties participating.

stories.headline: Musk-OpenAI Trial Nears High-Stakes Verdict
stories.summary: A nine-person jury is set to deliberate on the liability of OpenAI and its CEO, Sam Altman, in a high-stakes trial against Elon Musk. The trial, which began last month in an Oakland, California federal courthouse, has heard closing arguments from both parties. The jury's verdict will be advisory, with Judge Gonzalez Rogers making the final decision. If the jury finds in favor of Musk, the trial will proceed to a remedies phase, where the judge will determine the consequences. The case involves a dispute between Musk and OpenAI, with Microsoft also named in the suit. OpenAI recently transitioned to a public benefit corporation, with Microsoft receiving a 27% stake and the OpenAI Foundation receiving a stake valued at $130 billion. The jury's verdict is expected to have significant implications for the parties involved.

stories.headline: OpenAI Is Offering ChatGPT Plus To Citizens Of Malta For A Year
stories.summary: OpenAI has partnered with the Government of Malta to offer ChatGPT Plus to all Maltese residents and citizens for one year. The initiative, called "AI for All," includes a government-led AI literacy program and an AI education course developed by the University of Malta. Citizens who complete the course will receive free access to ChatGPT Plus for one year. The program aims to help people understand what AI is, its capabilities, and responsible usage. Malta is the first country to launch a partnership of this scale with OpenAI. The deal was announced on Saturday, with the goal of providing citizens with the skills and knowledge needed to utilize AI effectively. The "AI for All" initiative combines education and access to AI technology, making Malta a pioneer in AI adoption and literacy.

stories.headline: Google Unveils PaLM 2, Its Latest AI Model
stories.summary: Google has unveiled PaLM 2, its latest large language model, at Google I/O 2023. PaLM 2 is an upgraded version of its predecessor, offering improved language understanding, translation, and reasoning capabilities. This multipurpose tool is the foundation for several Google products, including Google Generative AI Search, Duet AI in Google Docs and Gmail, and Google Bard. PaLM 2 marks a significant advancement in artificial intelligence, enabling businesses to interact with information and automate processes more efficiently. The model integrates state-of-the-art AI advancements, aiming to bridge the gap with existing AI language tools on the market. With its enhanced capabilities, PaLM 2 is poised to revolutionize the way businesses operate and automate tasks, making it a cutting-edge technology in the field of artificial intelligence. Its applications are expected to be far-reaching, impacting various aspects of digital growth and development.

stories.headline: Meta Releases Llama, An AI Capable Of Processing Natural Language
stories.summary: Meta has released Llama, a large language model capable of processing natural language. The latest version, Llama 3.3, was announced by Meta's VP of generative AI, Ahmad Al-Dahle. The model has been pre-trained on approximately 15 trillion tokens of text from publicly available sources. Meta has taken an open-source approach to AI with its Llama family of models, enabling the creation of smaller models that are as capable as older midsize variants but require significantly less compute. The company has achieved this through improved AI training techniques and rebuilt technology infrastructure. Llama models are available in various sizes, including 8B and 70B parameters, and have been fine-tuned on publicly available instruction datasets to improve performance in natural language processing. The release is part of Meta's ongoing efforts to advance AI technology.
